description: This Java source file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for reporting purposes within the insurance management backend. It contains two static inner classes: ClaimsReportResponse and PremiumsReportResponse, which are used to structure report data related to claims and premiums, respectively.

classes.name: ClaimsReportResponse
classes.description: DTO for claims report data, including total claims, approvals, rejections, pending claims, and total payout amount.

classes.name: PremiumsReportResponse
classes.description: DTO for premiums report data, including total premiums collected and payment count.

methods.name: ClaimsReportResponse
methods.description: Constructor for ClaimsReportResponse, initializes report fields.

methods.name: PremiumsReportResponse
methods.description: Constructor for PremiumsReportResponse, initializes report fields.
